sentences.text:
Bench: T. Vinod Kumar
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice T. Vinod Kumar
 W.P.No.33443 of 2024
O R D E R:

Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for respondent Nos.1 to 6 and with the consent of the counsel appearing for the parties,
the Writ Petition is taken up for hearing and disposal at admission stage.

2. Shorn of unnecessary details, the case of the petitioners, in brief, is that though the 5th respondent had passed an Award, dt.13.12.2021, in respect of land of the petitioners in survey No.5/67 to an extent of Acres 4.00 guntas situated at Peddampalli Village, Kasipet Mandal,
however, having recorded existence of a title dispute, did not make reference to the Authority by exercising powers under Section 76 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short 'the Act'), for determination of the said dispute, as a result of which, the compensation amount receivable by the petitioners has not been paid till date, which action it is contended as highly illegal, arbitrary and contrary to the provisions of the Act.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. Per contra, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition has placed before this Court,
written instructions, dt.06.12.2024, under the signature of the 5th respondent-Revenue Divisional Officer, Bellampalli.

By the written instructions, the respondents-authorities while admitting to the fact of existence of a title dispute in respect of land in survey No.5/67 to an extent of Acres 4.00 guntas situated at Peddampalli Village, Kasipet Mandal, had prayed for issuance of necessary orders as this Court deems fit and proper in the circumstances of the case.
4. I have taken note of the respective submissions made.

5. A perusal of the Award, dt.13.12.2021, as passed by the 5th respondent-Authority shows that the said authority while passing the Award in respect of the land in survey No.5/67 to an extent of Acres 4.00 guntas situated at Peddampalli Village, Kasipet Mandal, had recorded that one D.Rama Rao,
who is the son of Smt Durgam Posu, had attended the Award enquiry and produced the death certificate of the pattadar and also claimed that he is the legal heir of the deceased person and requested to pay the compensation in respect of the land to an extent of Acres 4.00 guntas under the acquisition proceeding.

sentences.text: The 5th respondent-authority, however, took note of the objection petition stated to have been filed by one Somani Mallesh, S/o late Somani Posham claiming not to pay compensation in respect of the land in survey No.5/67 and concluded that there is a title dispute in respect of the said land and accordingly, noted in the Award that the compensation amount as awarded is kept pending till the rightful owner comes up with claim and title documents for realization of the compensation amount.

7. The 5th respondent-authority while noting as above, also observed that till the right person comes up with claim and title documents, the compensation amount would be referred to the Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority, Hyderabad, as per the "Apportionment Statement'.
8.

entities.text: Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority, Hyderabad
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Though the 5th respondent had noted as above, the said authority did not make reference to the Authority as provided under Section 76 of the Act, as a result of which the authority constituted under the Act, who is entitled to adjudicate the disputes as to the apportionment of the compensation amount, is not ceased of the matter as on date, even though more than three years had passed by from the date of passing of the Award.

9. However, by the written instructions as placed before this Court, the 5th respondent had stated that the authority had taken steps to refer the dispute between the petitioner herein and the 7th respondent to the Authority under Section 76 of the Act and that notice in this regard referring the matter to the authority has been issued to the petitioner on 06-12-2024, and a copy of the said notice is also being sent to the petitioner and the claimant viz.,7th respondent.

10. Having regard to the fact that the respondent authorities have now taken steps for referring the matter to the authority under Section 76 of the Act, this Court is of the view that the respondent are to be directed to complete the process of making reference including the deposit of compensation amount awarded forthwith to enable the authority under the Act to determine the rival claims after issuing notices.
11. Subject to the above observations and directions, the Writ Petition is disposed of.
12. Consequently, miscellaneous petitions, if any pending, shall stand closed.
